name: usage-pet
description: A usage band above the prompt — context, 5-hour limit, weekly limit, optional Fable weekly limit, cache hit rate — with Clawd, an animated pixel pet. For the Code tab of Claude Desktop.

language.title: Language / 语言
language.description: auto follows your system language; or type zh or en · auto 跟随系统语言，也可以填 zh 或 en

seasonal.title: Seasonal looks / 时段与节日装扮
seasonal.description: auto adds morning coffee, a nightcap, seasonal weather and holiday looks (Christmas: Dec 20–26; New Year: Dec 31–Jan 1; Halloween: Oct 25–Nov 1); type off to turn them all off · auto 添加早晨咖啡、夜帽、季节天气和节日装扮（圣诞节：12 月 20–26 日；新年：12 月 31 日至 1 月 1 日；万圣节：10 月 25 日至 11 月 1 日），填 off 全部关闭

tantrums.title: Tantrums / 烦躁反应
tantrums.description: on shows an angry stomp after 3 frustrated prompts in 20 minutes; type off to disable · on：20 分钟内 3 次烦躁提示后显示跺脚；填 off 关闭
